recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結免疫染色中，多個濾泡的套區呈寬大深棕色、中央小型退化生發中心也著色，濾泡間區陰性，呈 B 細胞標記分布；其中可見一套區包兩個生發中心（twinning）及穿入的小血管，支持 Castleman 病。標記未標示。
features: Numerous B-cell follicles with broad, strongly positive mantle zones
Small, atretic germinal centers, some with twinning (two germinal centers within one mantle)
Low-power pattern only; cytology not assessable
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain (DAB; marker not specified, distribution typical of a B-cell marker such as CD20) on a lymph node shows numerous follicles with expanded, strongly positive mantle zones surrounding small, regressed germinal centers, while the interfollicular zones are negative. One follicle contains two germinal centers within a shared mantle, and penetrating vessels are seen within germinal centers. The preserved follicular architecture with expanded mantles and atretic centers is consistent with hyaline-vascular Castleman disease, and the absence of sheets of positive cells in interfollicular areas argues against a B-cell lymphoma effacing the node.

ddx.vs: FL shows crowded back-to-back follicles with BCL2-positive germinal centers and thin or absent mantles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL shows expanded mantles composed of cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, CD5-positive monoclonal B cells.
Reactive follicles have large active germinal centers with thinner, non-onion-skinned mantles.

stain: IHC: marker not specified (B-cell pattern, likely CD20), DAB
